neighbours.label: the word that marks an attempt as having failed (fell short, turned down, narrowly missed, fell through, unsuccessfully), as against the same attempts succeeding
fire: The arrow fell short of the castle wall and landed in the moat.
The council turned down the plan for a new car park.
She narrowly missed winning a medal at the national games.
The sale of the house fell through when the buyer lost his job.
He campaigned unsuccessfully for a seat on the school board.
Our team just missed out on the playoffs this season.
The publisher turned down her first novel without comment.
The merger fell through after months of tense talks.
quiet: The arrow struck the castle wall just below the window.
The council approved the plan for a new car park.
She proudly won a medal at the national games.
The sale of the house closed when the buyer signed the papers.
He campaigned successfully for a seat on the school board.
Our team qualified for the playoffs this season.
The publisher accepted her first novel with a warm letter.
The merger went ahead after months of tense talks.
